2. The facts in short for the purpose of disposal of the Rule are that the petitioner being preemptor instituted the preemption case under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for pre-emption of the case land. The preemptee opposite parties also contested the case by filing written objection denying the material allegations made in the application for pre-emption. During proceeding of the Miscellaneous Case opposite party No. 6 of the preemption application, on his prayer was added as co-preemptor No. 2 in preemption proceeding on 23.4.1996. The preemptor-petitioner filed application on 22.8.1999 for addition of party's by way of amendment of the Miscellaneous Case and the said application was rejected on 13.1.2000 by the impugned order. 

 3. Mr. Subrata Saha, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner has taken me to the impugned order and submits that the preemptor-petitioner annexing sale deed dated 3.6.1972 with the application dated 22.8.1999 showing that Abdul Gani Mia alias Abdul Gani Choudhury sold land to Bachu Mia and as such Bachu Mia is necessary party in the pre-emption proceeding and sought for adding said Bachu Mia as opposite party to the Mis-cellaneous Case to meet the requirement of the provision made under Section 96 of the state Acquisition and Tenancy Act. But the learned Assistant Judge rejected the application holding that the petitioner by adding said Bachu Mia as opposite party wanted to make 3rd case in the Miscellaneous case and in not allowing the application committed error of law resulting in as error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. At that point of time Mr. Amjad Hossain, the learned Advocate for the opposite party with the leave of the Court appeared and urged to make submission on preliminary point of law as to the maintainability of this revisional application under Section 115 (1) of the Code of Civil Procedure. Mr. Amjad Hossain then referred to the Section 96(12) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and submits that this revisional application (this Rule) is not maintainable in view of provision of Section 96(12) State Acquisition and Tenancy Act.
